content: शुक्र {%a.%} [शुच्-रक् नि˚ कुत्वम् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 28</ls>] <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Bright, radiant; स पर्यगाच्छुकम् <ls>Īśop. 8</ls>; shining. .²2 White, pure; रोचिष्णु जायते शुक्रं तद्रूपगुणमुच्यते <ls>Mb. 12. 232. 6</ls>. .{@-क्रः@} .²1 The planet Venus. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the preceptor of the Asuras, who, by means of his magical charm, restored to life the demons killed in battle; see कच, देवयानी and ययाति. .²3 The month of Jyeṣṭha; रथस्वन इति ह्येते शुक्रमासं नयन्त्यमी <ls>Bhāg. 12. 11. 35</ls>. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Agni or fire. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the plant Chitraka. .{@-क्रम्@} .²1 Semen virile; पुमान् पुंसोऽधिके शुक्रे स्त्री भवत्यधिके स्त्रियाः <ls>Ms. 3. 49</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 63</ls>. .²2 The essence of anything. .²3 Male and female energy. .²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> Water. .²5 Brightness, clearness, light; यथा पुरस्तात् सविता दृश्यते शुक्रमुच्चरन् <ls>Mb. 5. 75. 12</ls>. .²6 Morbid affection of the iris. .²7 Gold, wealth.
